lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance circular spots arranged in approximately 5-6 visible vertical columns and 4-5 horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Fine vertical white bands intersect with the primary horizontal rows of spots, forming a geometric lattice pattern on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge is visible running horizontally across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with a highlight on the superior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense, labyrinthine pattern of high-intensity white lines and curves is visible on the dorsal region above the gill slits.
